A protocol exposing the hardware platform's capability set to overlay clients

interface.name: deck_platform_v1
interface.description:
Tells a client what the hardware it runs on can do, so an overlay can decide which of its functions to run without reading the product name itself. The set is fixed for the compositor's lifetime: it is derived from the hardware profile the compositor was started with, the same source bmc reports over gRPC.
The interface is event-only. Capabilities describe the board, not anything a client could change, so there is no request beyond the destructor.

enum.name: capability
enum.description: One bit per optional hardware function. A bit that is unset means the board has no such hardware or firmware path, and a client should not start the function that depends on it.

entry.name: mining
entry.summary: the board mines; a BOS API answers on the local host

event.name: capabilities
event.description: Emitted exactly once per resource, as the first event on bind, and static for the compositor's lifetime.
